observations.finding: Update payload map is read from new_version; names mapped with FirmwareFiles.valueOf.
Payloads stored under bare enum names; per-user firmware.file.names indexes the keys.
Null update model removes index only, not old bare-name strings.
ScioFirmwareFiles stores version metadata, not update-body data.
Producer constructs JSON key/value entries from file-list response before storing version metadata.
Read-header callback exposes checksum word at offset 12, not file body.
localChecksums gets U32LE from supplied four-byte prefix; not a checksum over body computed by the app.
Downloaded table prefixes compared with device header words for IDs 100..103.
Firmware transfer splits body into messages of at most 192 bytes; host-to-device path, not extraction command.

correction: Earlier RECOVERY_STATUS cache handoff conflated ScioFirmwareFiles metadata with actual bodies and overstated deletion on completion. Corrected in place; earlier immutable reports preserved.
limits: Exact Lab APK partial JADX output; targeted methods reviewed. No firmware body, checksum algorithm, table values, decompression or decryption recovered. No endpoint calls or device writes.
